Apache Camel’s runtime path is: **Component resolves an Endpoint → Endpoint creates Consumer/Producer → Consumer creates an Exchange and invokes the route’s Processor graph → reified EIPs execute through Pipeline/Channel wrappers → Send/Producer delivers to the destination.**
